records.jp: ……なんだか童心に返ったような気分になる。<CR>といっても、実際に遊んだことはないけれど
records.en_original: This makes me feel like a child again...even though I've never actually ridden one of these.
records.en: This makes me feel like a child again...even though I've never actually ridden one of these.

records.jp: （美弦さん、時々遠い目になるんだよなぁ。<CR>なんとなく距離を感じるっていうか……）
records.en_original: (Mio gets lost in her thoughts sometimes. It feels like there's a big distance between us...)
records.en: (Mio-san gets lost in her thoughts sometimes. It feels like there's a big distance between us...)

records.jp: （もっと気軽に話せるようになりたいなぁ）
records.en_original: (I wish we could be more comfortable with each other.)
records.en: (I wish we could be more comfortable with each other.)

records.en_original: Hmmmmm...
records.en: Hmmmmm...

records.jp: 愛央？
records.en_original: Ao?
records.en: Ao?

records.jp: そだ！　美弦さん、これで競走しよう！
records.en_original: I know! Let's race, Mio!
records.en: I know! Let's race, Mio-san!

records.jp: え？　競走？
records.en_original: Huh? Race?
records.en: Huh? Race?

records.jp: まったり乗ってるのも楽しいけど、<CR>絶対楽しい気がする！　やろ！　やろ！
records.en_original: Riding them like this is cool and all, but racing them would be so much fun! Let's do it! Come on!
records.en: Riding them like this is cool and all, but racing them would be so much fun! Let's do it! Come on!

records.jp: 愛央がそこまで言うなら……
records.en_original: Well, if you really want to...
records.en: Well, if you really want to...

records.jp: あ！　これで爆走してみない？
records.en_original: Ooh! Wanna see how fast we can go?
records.en: Ooh! Wanna see how fast we can go?

records.jp: 爆走？　でもこれ、そんなに速く動かないもの<CR>だと思うけれど？
records.en_original: Huh? I'm not sure these things can go all that fast.
records.en: Huh? I'm not sure these things can go all that fast.

records.jp: ふっふっふ。言われると思った
records.en_original: Heh heh heh. I thought you'd say that.
records.en: Heh heh heh. I thought you'd say that.

records.jp: こんなこともあろうかと思って、<CR>密かに爆走機能を搭載したのさ！
records.en_original: I secretly equipped these with a special boost function just for situations like this!
records.en: I secretly equipped these with a special boost function just for situations like this!

records.jp: いったい、なんのためにそんなこと……
records.en_original: Why on earth...
records.en: Why on earth...

records.jp: ここの耳を引っ張ると、超速モードになるよ！
records.en_original: Pull the ear like so to switch to Maximum Overdrive Mode!
records.en: Pull the ear like so to switch to Maximum Overdrive Mode!

records.jp: それじゃ、行くよー！
records.en_original: Okay, let's go!
records.en: Okay, let's go!

records.jp: はぁ、はぁ……<CR>何が何だか……
records.en_original: *Pant*... *Pant*... What just happened...?
records.en: *Pant*... *Pant*... What just happened...?

records.jp: ひゃー、楽しかったー！　それに……
records.en_original: Whoo-hoooo! That was awesome! And hey...
records.en: Whoo-hoooo! That was awesome! And hey...

records.jp: 美弦さんのあんな顔、初めて見ちゃった！<CR>えへへ！
records.en_original: I've never seen you make that face before, Mio! Ehehe!
records.en: I've never seen you make that face before, Mio-san! Ehehe!

records.jp: 私……そんなに珍しい表情をしていたかしら？
records.en_original: Did I...really make such a strange face?
records.en: Did I...really make such a strange face?

records.jp: 目をキラキラさせてムキになったりしてて、<CR>なんだか可愛かったよ！
records.en_original: Your eyes were all lit up, but you looked angry at the same time. It was kinda cute!
records.en: Your eyes were all lit up, but you looked angry at the same time. It was kinda cute!

records.jp: 可愛いなんて、そんなことは
records.en_original: That doesn't sound cute at all!
records.en: That doesn't sound cute at all!

records.jp: 美弦さんと一緒に遊べて、<CR>そこが一番嬉しかった、かな！
records.en_original: I'm so happy we could hang out, Mio!
records.en: I'm so happy we could hang out, Mio-san!

records.jp: 私と遊べて……嬉しかった？
records.en_original: You're happy you could hang out with me?
records.en: You're happy you could hang out with me?

records.jp: うん！　前より仲良しになれた気がして！
records.en_original: Yeah! I feel like we've gotten closer than we were before.
records.en: Yeah! I feel like we've gotten closer than we were before.

records.jp: それは……まあ、気のせいではないと思う
records.en_original: Oh... Yes, I suppose you could say that.
records.en: Oh... Yes, I suppose you could say that.

records.jp: 美弦さんて、いつも落ち着いてて賢くて、<CR>時々近寄りがたい雰囲気出してるから
records.en_original: You're always so calm and rational that it can be hard to approach you sometimes.
records.en: You're always so calm and smart, Mio-san, and sometimes you give off this unapproachable air.

records.jp: こんなバカみたいなの、一緒に遊んでくれて<CR>前より身近になれた感じ！
records.en_original: After a little dumb fun, I feel closer to you!
records.en: After a little dumb fun, I feel closer to you!

records.jp: ……馬鹿みたいだってことは、愛央も<CR>分かっていたわけね
records.en_original: ...So you knew it was dumb the whole time.
records.en: ...So you knew it was dumb the whole time.

records.jp: もっちろんだよ！
records.en_original: Of course!
records.en: Of course!

records.jp: だって、美弦さんが可愛い系のレトロ玩具に<CR>乗ってるだけでも珍しい図なのに
records.en_original: Seeing you on a cute animal like this was funny enough.
records.en: Just seeing you riding a cute retro toy is unusual enough, Mio-san.

records.jp: 今の、いまどき小学生男子でもやらないような<CR>悪ふざけじゃん！
records.en_original: But making them go so fast was the cherry on top! Not even little boys would pull a prank like that!
records.en: But making them go so fast was the cherry on top! Not even little boys would pull a prank like that!

records.jp: それじゃあ愛央は、小学生男子以下の<CR>精神年齢ってことかしら
records.en_original: In other words, even little boys are more mature than you are?
records.en: In other words, even little boys are more mature than you are?

records.jp: えええっ！　まさかの逆襲！？
records.en_original: Whoaaaa! What a comeback!
records.en: Whoaaaa! What a comeback!

records.jp: うっ。う、薄々はそうかなーって。<CR>でも、ついやってみたくなって、つい……
records.en_original: Aww. I mean, sort of, but I still wanted to try it...
records.en: Aww. I mean, sort of, but I still wanted to try it...

records.jp: まったく、馬鹿な子ほど可愛いって、<CR>このことね……
records.en_original: Jeez, now I know what people mean when they say the dumb ones are the cute ones...
records.en: Jeez, now I know what people mean when they say the dumb ones are the cute ones...

records.jp: 呆れられた！？<CR>じゃなくて、可愛いって言われた！？
records.en_original: Are you saying I'm dumb?! Wait, are you saying I'm cute?!
records.en: Are you saying I'm dumb?! Wait, are you saying I'm cute?!

records.jp: お馬鹿って言ったの。<CR>これはこんな風に遊ぶ玩具じゃないもの
records.en_original: I'm saying you're not the brightest bulb. These toys aren't meant to go that fast.
records.en: I'm saying you're not the brightest bulb. These toys aren't meant to go that fast.

records.jp: ううっ
records.en_original: Oh...
records.en: Oh...

records.jp: でも、楽しかったわ
records.en_original: It was fun, though.
records.en: It was fun, though.
